blocks.text: KORONADAL CITY – Seven Falls, one of South Cotabato’s major tourist spots in the scenic mountain town of Lake Sebu, is being upgraded with facilities designed to be friendly to persons with disabilities (PWDs) and senior citizens. Ray Venn Dongon, Seven Falls Project Management Unit manager, said management is working to develop PWD- and senior citizen-friendly facilities at Seven Falls to ensure visitors of all ages and abilities can enjoy the attraction. Improving Seven Falls is one of the provincial government’s priority tourism projects, with P25 million allotted for road and facility development.
